title: Site Construction Supervisor 4 Residential & Commercial building
description:
Highly detail-oriented and safety-driven Construction Site Supervisor with over 15 years of hands-on experience managing comprehensive residential and commercial build projects. Proven track record in orchestrating structural phases (foundations, columns, beams), handling masonry, overseeing MEP services (electrical, plumbing, drainage), and executing high-end finishing work (plastering, tiling, painting, flooring). Adept at managing specialized subcontractors, maintaining rigorous quality control, enforcing OSHA/HSE guidelines, and keeping complex projects strictly on schedule and within budget. 
 Role & responsibilities 
 Core Competencies & Execution Profile 1. Structural & Core Civil Works Foundation Laying: Supervise site clearance, setting out via profile boards, excavation, leveling, compaction, reinforcement mesh placement, and pouring concrete footings (pad, strip, or raft). Columns & Beams: Coordinate precise shuttering/formwork, rebar tying (stirrups, main bars) according to structural drawings, column starters, casting, and vibrator compaction. Track curing timelines for lintels, plinth beams, and main roof slabs. Wall Construction: Oversee brick/block laying layout, ensuring accurate alignment, verticality (plumb bob checks), mortar mix ratios (cement:sand), and integration of lintel bands. 2. MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) Supervision Plumbing Systems: Direct underground and internal plumbing network installations. Ensure correct pipe slope/gradient for waste lines and manage pressure testing for supply lines before casting or wall closure. Electrical Infrastructure: Oversee the installation of conduit pipes, junction boxes, and DB (Distribution Board) boxing within slabs and walls prior to plastering to eliminate structural modifications later. Drainage Systems: Coordinate exterior drainage systems, soakaways, septic tank connections, and gully traps, maintaining strict flow vectors to prevent backups. 3. Finishing & Aesthetic Execution Plastering & Screeding: Monitor wall surface preparation, hacking on concrete elements, patch checks, and cement-sand ratios for internal/external plastering to ensure perfectly flat, crack-free finishes. Tiling & Flooring: Supervise floor base preparation (PCC/German floor). Manage tile layout patterns, spacer usage, level layouts via water level or lasers, and proper grout filling for tiles, marble, or granite. Painting & Final Touches: Inspect wall curing, primer/putty application, screeding, and final multi-coat paint applications to avoid peeling or discoloration. 
 Key Responsibilities & On-Site Duties Blueprint Interpretation: Translate complex structural, architectural, and MEP layout drawings into actionable instructions for site artisans and masons. Subcontractor Coordination: Manage and schedule specialized crews (plumbers, electricians, tilers, painters, and carpenters) to avoid workflow overlaps and delays. Quality Assurance (QA/QC): Conduct routine inspections at every stageverifying structural rebar before concrete pours, measuring tile levels, and testing pipe connections for leaks. Material & Inventory Management: Monitor raw materials (cement, aggregate, rebar, pipes, cables, tiles) to minimize waste and coordinate just-in-time delivery schedules. Safety & Compliance: Enforce strict on-site health and safety regulations (HSE), ensure consistent use of PPE, conduct regular toolbox talks, and maintain a hazard-free workplace. Reporting: Prepare accurate daily, weekly, and monthly progress logs, tracking material consumption and labor attendance for the Project Manager. 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 Professional Qualifications Education: Diploma in Civil Engineering, Building Technology, or Construction Management (or equivalent field-verified experience). Certifications: Site Supervisor Certification, OSHA/HSE safety compliance certification, or First Aid training. Minimum 15 years construction experience in all aspects of Residential building / commercial building construction Must have Experience in structural aspects of building construction. Must have Experience in MEP aspects of building construction. Must have experience in Finishing aspects of building constructions. Must have experience in GCC region for Residential and Commercial building project completion. 
 General Terms and condition: 1) All the vacancies are for Nigeria 2) Mobilization immediately. 3) Bachelor position status only 4) Apply with CV, last salary certificate, degree certificate, notice period. 5) Two reference with Mobile number, email and address is must. 6) Company will provide: Visa, Local transportation, Medical, bachelor accommodation, Food Assistance 7) Leave 15 days after 8 months first time and thereafter every 6 months. 8) Air tickets for joining services of company and leave rotation. 9) Company will provide USD salary + local allowance 10) Fluency in written and spoken English is must.
